title: 建築模組化吊裝與接合~Volumetric modular-building lifting and connections
focus: 以角柱荷載路徑、模組間繫結、吊具設計與堆疊公差控制，讓工廠製造的體積模組安全成為整體建築~Corner-post load paths, inter-module ties, lifting-gear design and stacking-tolerance control that turn factory-made volumetric modules safely into one building
summary: 從體積模組的角柱荷載路徑與雙層樓板出發，說明模組間繫結與防連續倒塌、角部接頭與螺栓接合、吊點與吊裝框，再處理起重機選型與風速限制、堆疊公差與墊片、工廠出廠檢驗、現場接頭與防火防水檢查，最後談模組間空腔的耐久與模組履歷交接，並以新加坡 The Clement Canopy、紐約 461 Dean Street 與蒙特婁 Habitat 67 對照。~Starting from corner-post load paths and double floors in volumetric modules, explain inter-module ties and progressive-collapse resistance, corner joints and bolting, lift points and lifting frames, then crane selection and wind limits, stacking tolerances and shims, factory release inspection, site joint, fire-stopping and waterproofing checks, and finally durability of inter-module cavities and module-record handover, compared with The Clement Canopy in Singapore, 461 Dean Street in New York and Habitat 67 in Montreal.

units.anchor: 角柱與雙層樓板~Corner posts and double floors
units.title: 體積模組的荷載路徑與結構系統~Load paths and structural systems of volumetric modules
units.mechanism: 體積模組是在工廠完成結構、隔間、機電與裝修的立體箱體，到工地後像積木一樣堆疊。鋼構模組通常以四角的方管柱與上下框梁承受重力，荷載沿角柱一路往下傳；新加坡 PPVC 一類的混凝土模組則以六面混凝土板承重。每個模組都有自己的地板與天花板，形成雙層樓板與雙層牆，自重與樓高都比傳統構造大；較高的模組建築通常另以現澆混凝土核心筒或斜撐承受側力。~A volumetric module is a three-dimensional box whose structure, partitions, services and finishes are completed in a factory and then stacked on site like building blocks. Steel modules usually carry gravity through square hollow-section posts at the four corners and top and bottom edge beams, so load runs down the corner posts; concrete modules such as Singapore's PPVC carry it through six-sided concrete panels. Every module has its own floor and ceiling, giving double floors and walls that add weight and storey height compared with conventional construction, and taller modular buildings usually resist lateral load with a cast-in-place concrete core or bracing.
units.model: 模組 3.6 m × 12 m = 43.2 m²，靜載 4.0 kPa（雙層樓板與天花）、活載 2.0 kPa，設計荷重 1.2×4.0 + 1.6×2.0 = 8.0 kPa，每模組每層 43.2×8.0 = 345.6 kN，由 4 根角柱各分擔 86.4 kN；上方 10 層累積 864 kN。角柱採 200×200×10 mm 方管（面積約 7,600 mm²），軸應力約 864,000/7,600 ≈ 114 MPa。數值為教學假設。~A 3.6 m × 12 m module covers 43.2 m²; with 4.0 kPa dead load (double floor and ceiling) and 2.0 kPa live load the design load is 1.2×4.0 + 1.6×2.0 = 8.0 kPa, so each module carries 43.2×8.0 = 345.6 kN per storey, 86.4 kN on each of four corner posts; ten storeys above accumulate 864 kN. A 200×200×10 mm SHS post (area about 7,600 mm²) then sees about 864,000/7,600 ≈ 114 MPa axial stress. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 結構分析要以實際的角柱、框梁與接頭勁度建立堆疊模型，檢查角柱軸力、局部壓屈與接頭承壓；並核對模組之間是否真如假設只在角部傳力（例如墊塊或承壓板位置），工廠以抽樣試驗確認方管與焊接品質。~The structural analysis should model the stack with the actual stiffness of corner posts, edge beams and joints, checking post axial force, local buckling and joint bearing, and confirm that modules really bear on each other only at the corners as assumed (for example at packers or bearing plates); the factory confirms hollow-section and weld quality by sample testing.
units.failure: 若模組間在樓板邊緣意外接觸而非只在角部承壓，荷載會流入未設計承壓的框梁，造成局部變形與裝修開裂；角柱接頭偏心產生附加彎矩，可能使高層堆疊下方的角柱提早壓屈。~If modules accidentally bear along floor edges rather than only at the corners, load flows into edge beams not designed for bearing, causing local distortion and cracked finishes; eccentric corner joints add bending that can buckle lower corner posts early in a tall stack.
units.misconception: 模組在工廠已經做好結構，堆疊後不需要整體結構分析。~Since each module's structure is finished in the factory, the stacked building needs no overall structural analysis.
units.practice: 結構設計者要在圖上標明每一處模組間的承壓點、墊塊材料與厚度，並把「非承壓區保持間隙」列為安裝檢查項目；超過一定層數的模組建築須設計獨立的抗側力系統並經結構審查。~The structural designer must mark every inter-module bearing point, packer material and thickness on the drawings and make ‘keep non-bearing zones clear’ an installation check item; modular buildings above a set height need an independent lateral system, designed and passed through structural review.

units.anchor: 模組間水平繫結~Inter-module horizontal ties
units.title: 側向力傳遞、整體性與防連續倒塌~Lateral load transfer, robustness and progressive collapse
units.mechanism: 側向風力與地震力先由每個模組的樓板與天花板收集，再透過模組間的水平連接板傳到核心筒或斜撐模組。模組之間只靠少數點連接，若連接設計不足，建築在偶發事件中缺乏整體性，一個模組受損就可能讓相鄰模組失去支承。因此設計要提供水平與垂直繫結，並檢核移除一個模組或一根角柱後，上方荷載能否由懸臂作用或繫結重新分配，這是模組建築防止連續倒塌的核心。~Wind and seismic forces are first collected by each module's floor and ceiling, then passed through horizontal inter-module plates to the core or braced modules. Modules are joined at only a few points, so weak connections leave the building without integrity in an accident, and damage to one module can strip support from its neighbours. The design must therefore provide horizontal and vertical ties and check whether, with one module or corner post removed, the load above can be redistributed by cantilever action or ties; this is the core of preventing progressive collapse in modular buildings.
units.model: 參考 EN 1991-1-7 附錄 A 的內部繫結型式 T = 0.8(g_k + ψq_k)·s·L，且不小於 75 kN。取 g_k = 4.0 kPa、ψq_k = 0.5×2.0 = 1.0 kPa、間距 s = 3.6 m、跨度 L = 12 m：T = 0.8×5.0×3.6×12 = 172.8 kN > 75 kN，故每處水平繫結須承受約 173 kN 拉力。數值為教學假設。~Following the internal-tie form of EN 1991-1-7 Annex A, T = 0.8(g_k + ψq_k)·s·L but not less than 75 kN. With g_k = 4.0 kPa, ψq_k = 0.5×2.0 = 1.0 kPa, spacing s = 3.6 m and span L = 12 m: T = 0.8×5.0×3.6×12 = 172.8 kN > 75 kN, so each horizontal tie must resist about 173 kN of tension. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以模型分析每一處模組間連接在風與地震下的剪力與拉力，並做移除單一模組的替代路徑分析；連接件以原型試驗確認強度與滑移，現場逐一檢查繫結板是否安裝、螺栓是否齊全。~Analyse shear and tension at every inter-module connection under wind and earthquake, and run alternate-path analysis with a single module removed; confirm connector strength and slip by prototype testing, and on site check one by one that tie plates are installed and every bolt is present.
units.failure: 為了方便安裝而省略部分模組間繫結，或把繫結板只以點焊臨時固定後忘記補強，正常使用時看不出問題，一旦發生瓦斯爆炸或車輛撞擊，局部破壞便可能沿著缺乏繫結的模組擴大。~Omitting some inter-module ties for easier installation, or tack-welding tie plates temporarily and never completing them, shows nothing in normal use, but a gas explosion or vehicle impact can then spread local damage through the untied modules.
units.misconception: 模組只要上下疊好，自重就足以讓建築維持整體性。~As long as modules are stacked properly, self-weight alone keeps the building intact.
units.practice: 結構設計須提出繫結配置圖與連續倒塌檢核，每一處繫結都是安裝保留點：未經檢查員確認繫結完成，不得在其上方繼續堆疊下一層模組。~The structural design must provide a tie layout and progressive-collapse check, and every tie becomes an installation hold point: no further module may be stacked above until the inspector confirms the tie is complete.

units.anchor: 角部定位錐與連接板~Corner locating cones and plates
units.title: 模組角部接頭與螺栓接合~Module corner joints and bolted connections
units.mechanism: 鋼構模組的角部接頭同時負責垂直定位與水平連接：常見做法是在下方模組頂部設定位錐或插銷，上方模組落下時自動對位，再以螺栓連接板把相鄰模組拉在一起。困難在於接頭位於模組內部或狹窄間隙中，螺栓必須能從外側、預留手孔或上一層施工面鎖固，否則既無法施作也無法檢查。混凝土 PPVC 則以預留鋼筋、續接器與灌漿形成濕式接頭，灌漿飽滿度是品質關鍵。~Corner joints in steel modules provide both vertical location and horizontal connection: a common approach puts locating cones or pins on top of the lower module so the upper module self-aligns as it is lowered, then bolted plates pull adjacent modules together. The difficulty is that the joints sit inside modules or in narrow gaps, so bolts must be tightenable from outside, through access holes or from the next working level, or they can neither be installed nor inspected. Concrete PPVC uses projecting bars, couplers and grout to form wet joints, where complete grout filling is the key to quality.
units.model: 繫結力 172.8 kN 以 8.8 級 M20 螺栓單剪承擔，每支 F_v,Rd = 0.6×800×245/1.25 ≈ 94.1 kN，需 172.8/94.1 ≈ 1.84，取 2 支；若為了吸收公差改用長槽孔，承壓與滑移檢核更嚴，常需增加為 3 支或改用摩阻型接合。數值為教學假設。~Resisting the 172.8 kN tie force with grade 8.8 M20 bolts in single shear, each gives F_v,Rd = 0.6×800×245/1.25 ≈ 94.1 kN, so 172.8/94.1 ≈ 1.84 and two bolts are needed; long slotted holes used to absorb tolerances make bearing and slip checks stricter, often requiring three bolts or a slip-resistant connection. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以足尺接頭原型做拉力與剪力試驗，確認強度與滑移量；安裝後檢查螺栓數量、墊圈、鎖固順序與標記，混凝土接頭則以灌漿量紀錄、試體強度與必要時的非破壞檢測確認飽滿。~Test full-scale joint prototypes in tension and shear to confirm strength and slip; after installation check bolt count, washers, tightening sequence and marking, and for concrete joints confirm complete filling from grout-volume records, cube strengths and non-destructive testing where needed.
units.failure: 接頭在圖面上可行，現場卻因相鄰模組的牆板擋住而放不進扳手，工人只好少鎖或改焊，接頭強度與可檢查性都無從保證；灌漿接頭若排氣不良留下空洞，鋼筋無法發揮錨定。~A joint that works on paper cannot take a wrench on site because the neighbouring module's wall panel is in the way, so workers fit fewer bolts or weld instead, leaving strength and inspectability unknown; a grouted joint with poor venting leaves voids so bars cannot develop anchorage.
units.misconception: 模組接頭只要強度計算通過，安裝方式可以留給現場決定。~Once a module joint passes the strength calculation, how it is installed can be left to the site.
units.practice: 接頭設計要以三維模型檢查扳手與手孔的施工空間，並在工廠以實體樣品演練；任何接頭形式的變更都須由結構設計者重新簽認，並更新安裝程序書。~Check wrench and access-hole space for every joint in the 3D model and rehearse it on a physical sample at the factory; any change to a joint type must be re-signed by the structural designer and reflected in the installation method statement.

units.anchor: 吊點與吊裝框~Lift points and lifting frame
units.title: 吊點設計、吊具與模組變形~Lift points, lifting frames and module distortion
units.mechanism: 模組是大而薄的箱體，吊裝時的受力與使用時完全不同：若四條吊索直接斜拉到吊鉤，吊索的水平分力會向內壓擠模組頂框，可能使框架變形、牆板與裝修開裂，所以常用吊裝框或吊梁讓吊索保持垂直。浴室、廚房與機電設備使重心偏離幾何中心，吊起時模組會傾斜，需調整吊點或吊索長度。吊點與吊具屬於臨時工程，必須依起重相關標準設計、標示額定荷重並做荷重試驗。~A module is a large, thin box whose forces in lifting differ completely from those in service: four slings pulled straight to the hook push inward on the top frame with their horizontal components, which can distort the frame and crack wall panels and finishes, so a lifting frame or spreader beam keeps the slings vertical. Bathrooms, kitchens and plant shift the centre of gravity away from the geometric centre, so the module tilts when lifted unless lift points or sling lengths are adjusted. Lift points and lifting gear are temporary works that must be designed to lifting-equipment standards, marked with their rated load and load-tested.
units.model: 模組 25 t、動力係數 1.2，吊重 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN。四肢吊索與水平成 60° 時，每肢張力 T = 294/(4 sin 60°) ≈ 85.0 kN，水平分力 T cos 60° ≈ 42.5 kN 向內壓擠頂框；改用吊裝框使吊索垂直後，每肢 294/4 ≈ 73.6 kN，水平分力趨近 0。數值為教學假設。~A 25 t module with a dynamic factor of 1.2 gives a hook load of 25×9.81×1.2 ≈ 294 kN. With four sling legs at 60° to the horizontal, each leg carries T = 294/(4 sin 60°) ≈ 85.0 kN and its horizontal component T cos 60° ≈ 42.5 kN squeezes the top frame inward; a lifting frame that keeps slings vertical gives 294/4 ≈ 73.6 kN per leg with nearly zero horizontal component. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 吊點以計算與荷重試驗確認，吊裝框依 EN 13155 一類標準設計並標示額定荷重與自重；每種模組型式在工廠先試吊，量測離地後的傾斜角與框架變形並與重心計算比較，調整後才放行運送。~Confirm lift points by calculation and load test, design the lifting frame to standards such as EN 13155 and mark it with rated load and self-weight; trial-lift each module type at the factory, measuring tilt and frame distortion once clear of the ground against the centre-of-gravity calculation, and release it for shipping only after adjustment.
units.failure: 未用吊裝框而直接斜拉吊索，模組頂框被壓彎，落位後門框變形、石膏板接縫開裂；重心估算錯誤使模組在高空傾斜，接近定位時撞擊已安裝的模組，造成損壞並威脅下方人員。~Slinging directly at an angle without a lifting frame bends the module's top frame, so after setting the door frames are distorted and plasterboard joints crack; a wrong centre-of-gravity estimate tilts the module at height so it strikes already-installed modules on approach, causing damage and endangering people below.
units.misconception: 模組既然能承受使用荷載，用任何方式吊起來都不會受損。~Since a module can carry service loads, any way of lifting it will do no harm.
units.practice: 每種模組都要有吊裝計算書與吊點圖，標示重量、重心與吊具配置；吊具須有荷重試驗證明與定期檢查紀錄，吊裝計畫由合格的吊掛負責人簽核，現場依核准的計畫作業。~Every module type needs a lifting calculation and lift-point drawing showing weight, centre of gravity and rigging arrangement; lifting gear needs load-test certificates and periodic inspection records, and the lifting plan is signed by a competent lifting supervisor and followed as approved on site.

units.anchor: 起重半徑與受風面積~Crane radius and wind area
units.title: 起重機選型、吊裝順序與風速限制~Crane selection, lifting sequence and wind limits
units.mechanism: 模組重量集中、外形大，起重機選型要同時考慮吊重、半徑與吊高，最遠、最重的模組通常決定起重機規格。模組像一面帆，受風面積遠大於鋼梁，風會讓吊在空中的模組旋轉與擺動，使定位困難並可能撞擊結構，所以模組吊裝的允許風速通常低於一般吊裝。吊裝順序要讓結構在每個階段都穩定，並配合即時進場的運輸排程，減少工地堆置。~Modules are heavy and bulky, so crane selection must consider load, radius and hook height together, and the farthest, heaviest module usually sets the crane size. A module acts like a sail with far more wind area than a steel beam, so wind turns and swings it in the air, making placement difficult and risking impact with the structure; module lifting therefore usually has a lower permissible wind speed than ordinary lifting. The lifting sequence must keep the structure stable at every stage and match just-in-time delivery to minimise storage on site.
units.model: 模組受風面積 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m²，C_d = 1.2、ρ = 1.25 kg/m³：風速 10 m/s 時 F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N，15 m/s 時 6,480 N。相對於 25 t（約 245 kN）的重量，偏擺角約 atan(6.48/245) ≈ 1.5°，吊索長 40 m 時水平偏移約 40×6.48/245 ≈ 1.06 m。數值為教學假設。~A module face of 12 m × 3.2 m = 38.4 m² with C_d = 1.2 and ρ = 1.25 kg/m³ takes F = 0.5×1.25×10²×1.2×38.4 = 2,880 N at 10 m/s and 6,480 N at 15 m/s. Against a 25 t weight of about 245 kN the swing angle is about atan(6.48/245) ≈ 1.5°, so with 40 m of hoist rope the horizontal offset is about 40×6.48/245 ≈ 1.06 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 吊裝前核對每一模組的出廠秤重、吊具重量與半徑，對照起重機荷重表；現場以風速計在吊高處量測陣風，超過計畫門檻即暫停；每次吊裝記錄模組編號、重量、風速與定位時間，作為後續吊次規劃依據。~Before lifting, check each module's weighed factory mass, rigging weight and radius against the crane load chart; measure gusts at hook height with an anemometer and stop when the planned limit is exceeded; record module number, weight, wind speed and placement time for every lift to inform later lift planning.
units.failure: 以設計重量而非出廠秤重規劃吊次，裝修與設備增加的重量使部分吊次超過起重機在該半徑的能力；在陣風中勉強吊裝，模組旋轉撞擊鷹架，拉牽引繩的工人被拖行受傷。~Planning lifts from design weights instead of weighed factory masses lets added finishes and equipment push some lifts beyond the crane's capacity at that radius; forcing a lift in gusts spins the module into scaffolding and drags tag-line workers, injuring them.
units.misconception: 只要起重機額定荷重夠大，任何風速都可以吊模組。~If the crane's rated capacity is large enough, modules can be lifted at any wind speed.
units.practice: 吊裝計畫須列出每一吊次的重量、半徑、使用率、允許風速、牽引繩配置與禁區，經吊掛負責人與工地主任核准；風速、能見度或通訊不符條件時，吊掛負責人有權也有義務停止作業。~The lifting plan must list weight, radius, utilisation, permissible wind speed, tag-line arrangement and exclusion zone for every lift, approved by the lifting supervisor and site manager; when wind, visibility or communications fall outside the conditions, the lifting supervisor has both the authority and the duty to stop work.

units.anchor: 墊片與堆疊標高~Shims and stack levels
units.title: 堆疊公差、墊片與垂直度控制~Stacking tolerances, shims and verticality control
units.mechanism: 每個模組出廠時都有高度、長度與方正度的製造公差，堆疊時這些偏差會逐層累積，墊塊壓縮、接頭間隙與裙樓轉換層的平整度也會加入。若不控制，高樓層模組的樓板會越來越不水平、外牆線條歪斜，帷幕或外牆板接縫寬度失控。因此安裝時每隔幾層就要量測標高與垂直度並以墊片修正，裙樓或轉換層頂面的精度要求也必須比一般樓板嚴格。~Every module leaves the factory with height, length and squareness tolerances, and in stacking these deviations accumulate floor by floor, joined by packer compression, joint gaps and the flatness of the podium or transfer level. Uncontrolled, upper module floors drift out of level, façade lines lean and cladding joint widths run out of control. Installation therefore measures level and verticality every few storeys and corrects with shims, and the top of the podium or transfer level needs tighter accuracy than an ordinary slab.
units.model: 每個模組高度公差 ±3 mm、堆疊 30 層：最壞情況累積 30×3 = 90 mm，隨機合成約 √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm。若墊塊壓縮比預期少而每層系統偏高 +1 mm，30 層再加 30 mm，隨機與系統合計可能超出外牆接縫 ±20 mm 的調整範圍，所以每 5 層以墊片歸零一次。數值為教學假設。~With ±3 mm height tolerance per module over 30 storeys, worst-case accumulation is 30×3 = 90 mm and random combination about √30×3 ≈ 16.4 mm. If packers compress less than expected so each storey sits 1 mm high, 30 storeys add 30 mm systematically, and random plus systematic error may exceed a ±20 mm façade joint adjustment range, so levels are reset with shims every five storeys. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每安裝一層，以全測站量測模組角點的標高與平面位置，計算與設計的偏差並繪成趨勢；每 5 層做一次整體垂直度與標高檢核，結果連動下一批模組的墊片厚度計畫，並在開始堆疊前先驗收裙樓頂面。~After each level, measure corner levels and plan positions with a total station, compute deviations from design and plot the trend; every five storeys check overall verticality and level, link the results to the shim plan for the next batch, and accept the podium top surface before stacking starts.
units.failure: 裙樓轉換層頂面不平而未先修正，第一層模組就帶著傾斜，後續每層依前一層對位使傾斜延續到頂部，帷幕外牆接縫上寬下窄，只能在高樓層以異形板件收邊。~An uneven podium transfer slab left uncorrected tilts the first module level, each later level aligns to the one below so the tilt continues to the roof, and façade joints widen toward the top, ending in special-shaped closure panels at high level.
units.misconception: 只要每個模組都在製造公差內，堆疊後整棟建築也必然在公差內。~If every module is within its fabrication tolerance, the stacked building must be too.
units.practice: 安裝程序書應規定量測頻率、墊片材料與最大厚度、歸零樓層與允許偏差；裙樓頂面驗收列為開始堆疊前的保留點，由測量主管與結構設計者共同簽認。~The installation method statement must set measurement frequency, shim material and maximum thickness, reset levels and permitted deviations, with podium acceptance as a hold point before stacking begins, signed jointly by the survey lead and the structural designer.

units.title: 工廠製造檢驗與尺寸驗收~Factory inspection and dimensional acceptance
units.mechanism: 模組化的品質大部分在工廠決定：結構焊接、尺寸方正、防水層、防火封堵與機電管線都在出廠前完成，到工地後很難再打開檢查。因此工廠要建立與工地同等嚴格的檢驗制度，包含原物料證明、焊接檢查、尺寸量測、給排水試壓與電氣測試，並由第三方或主管機關在廠內查驗。ICC/MBI 1205 規範廠內與現場檢查及法規符合程序，新加坡則對 PPVC 製造廠實施認證制度。~Most of a module's quality is decided in the factory: structural welds, dimensional squareness, waterproofing, fire stopping and services are all complete before shipping and hard to open up again on site. The factory therefore needs an inspection regime as strict as on site, covering material certificates, weld inspection, dimensional measurement, plumbing pressure tests and electrical tests, with in-plant inspection by third parties or the authority. ICC/MBI 1205 sets in-plant and on-site inspection and regulatory-compliance procedures, and Singapore runs an accreditation scheme for PPVC manufacturers.
units.model: 3.6 m × 12.0 m 模組的理論對角線 √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m。實測兩對角線 12.531 m 與 12.522 m，差 9 mm，大於教學假設的允許差 6 mm，表示框架歪斜，須在出廠前調整，否則角部接頭到現場將無法對位。數值為教學假設。~The theoretical diagonal of a 3.6 m × 12.0 m module is √(3.6² + 12.0²) = √156.96 ≈ 12.528 m. Measured diagonals of 12.531 m and 12.522 m differ by 9 mm, more than an assumed allowable 6 mm, showing a racked frame that must be corrected before shipping or the corner joints will not align on site. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每個模組出廠前完成檢查表：對角線與高度量測、焊接目視與抽樣非破壞檢測、試水與試壓、電氣絕緣測試、防火封堵照片，由廠內品管與第三方簽名；檢查表與模組編號綁定，隨模組送到工地供驗收比對。~Before shipping, complete a checklist for each module: diagonal and height measurements, visual and sampled non-destructive weld testing, water and pressure tests, electrical insulation tests and photographs of fire stopping, signed by factory QA and a third party; the checklist is tied to the module number and travels with it for comparison at site acceptance.
units.failure: 工廠為了趕交期而跳過試水與試壓，模組堆疊後才發現衛浴管線接頭滲漏，只能拆除已完成的裝修甚至吊出模組；尺寸歪斜的模組被勉強安裝，接頭只能在現場切割修改。~A factory that skips water and pressure tests to meet deadlines finds bathroom pipe joints leaking only after the modules are stacked, forcing removal of finished linings or even lifting modules back out; racked modules forced into place can only be connected by cutting joints on site.
units.misconception: 模組在工廠製造，品質自然比工地好，不需要另外檢驗。~Factory-made modules are naturally better than site work, so no separate inspection is needed.
units.practice: 合約要求工廠品質計畫、檢查表樣式與第三方查驗頻率，並設出廠放行保留點：未完成檢查表與簽認的模組不得裝車；工地收貨時再以抽樣量測確認運輸未造成損傷。~The contract should require a factory quality plan, checklist format and third-party inspection frequency, with a release hold point so no module without a completed, signed checklist is loaded; at site receipt, sample measurements confirm that transport caused no damage.

units.anchor: 螺栓預拉力與封堵檢查~Bolt preload and sealing checks
units.title: 現場接頭、防火封堵與防水檢查~Site joints, fire stopping and waterproofing checks
units.mechanism: 模組落位後還有一連串現場工作決定成敗：螺栓鎖固與檢查、灌漿或現場焊接、模組間防水接縫、屋頂與外牆的臨時防護，以及模組之間的防火封堵與隔音。這些位置多半在吊裝後很快被下一個模組遮住，所以必須跟著吊裝節奏逐層檢查。螺栓預拉力透過扭矩係數與鎖固扭矩相關，而扭矩係數會隨表面狀況改變，重要接頭宜以校正過的工具配合轉角法等方式確認。~After a module is set, a chain of site work decides success: bolt tightening and checks, grouting or site welding, waterproof joints between modules, temporary protection of roof and façade, and fire stopping and acoustic sealing between modules. Most of these locations are soon hidden by the next module, so they must be inspected level by level at the pace of lifting. Bolt preload depends on tightening torque through a torque coefficient that varies with surface condition, so critical joints should be confirmed with calibrated tools and methods such as turn-of-nut.
units.model: 預拉力 F_p = 0.7·f_ub·A_s = 0.7×800×245 ≈ 137.2 kN（8.8 級 M20）。以 T = K·F·d 估算扭矩，K = 0.20、d = 0.020 m：T = 0.20×137,200×0.020 ≈ 549 N·m；若潤滑使 K 降為 0.14，同樣扭矩會產生約 137.2×0.20/0.14 ≈ 196 kN，可能超出螺栓降伏。數值為教學假設。~Preload F_p = 0.7·f_ub·A_s = 0.7×800×245 ≈ 137.2 kN for an M20 grade 8.8 bolt. Estimating torque by T = K·F·d with K = 0.20 and d = 0.020 m gives T = 0.20×137,200×0.020 ≈ 549 N·m; if lubrication lowers K to 0.14, the same torque produces about 137.2×0.20/0.14 ≈ 196 kN, possibly beyond bolt yield. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每層吊裝後由檢查員確認螺栓數量、鎖固標記與抽樣扭矩，灌漿接頭檢查灌漿紀錄；在下一個模組覆蓋前拍照記錄防火封堵與防水接縫，並對外牆接縫做試水，紀錄與模組編號連結。~After each level is lifted, an inspector confirms bolt count, tightening marks and sampled torque, and checks grout records for grouted joints; before the next module covers them, fire stopping and waterproof joints are photographed, façade joints are water-tested, and records are linked to module numbers.
units.failure: 為趕吊裝進度讓下一個模組先覆蓋，未檢查的接頭從此無法進入；防火封堵遺漏使模組間空腔連通多個樓層，日後火災時煙與火沿空腔蔓延。~Rushing the lifting sequence so the next module covers joints before inspection leaves them permanently inaccessible; missing fire stopping links inter-module cavities through several floors so that in a later fire smoke and flame travel along the cavities.
units.misconception: 扳手鎖到規定扭矩，就代表螺栓預拉力一定正確。~Tightening to the specified torque guarantees the correct bolt preload.
units.practice: 把接頭檢查、防火封堵與防水接縫列為每一層的保留點，未經檢查員簽認不得吊放覆蓋該處的模組；扭矩工具定期校正，並先在工地以預拉力試驗確認扭矩係數。~Make joint checks, fire stopping and waterproof joints a hold point at every level, with no covering module lifted until the inspector signs off; calibrate torque tools regularly and confirm the torque coefficient on site with preload tests first.

units.title: 模組間空腔的防火、防潮與耐久~Fire, moisture and durability of inter-module cavities
units.mechanism: 模組建築的雙層牆與雙層樓板之間形成許多隱藏空腔，它們讓模組能獨立製造，卻也帶來耐久與防火風險：施工期間未覆蓋的模組頂部遇雨，水會流入空腔與隔熱材中久久不乾；空腔若沒有分隔，火煙可沿著它跨越樓層；鋼接頭藏在空腔內，長期潮濕會鏽蝕卻難以檢查。因此設計要提供空腔分隔、排水與通風路徑，並規劃日後的檢查開口。~The double walls and floors of modular buildings create many concealed cavities that allow modules to be made independently but bring durability and fire risks: rain on uncovered module tops during construction runs into cavities and insulation and stays wet for a long time, unsubdivided cavities let fire and smoke cross floors, and steel joints hidden inside can corrode in long-term damp while being hard to inspect. The design must therefore provide cavity barriers, drainage and ventilation paths and plan inspection openings for later.
units.model: 一個 3.6 m × 12 m 模組頂面 43.2 m²，若未覆蓋時遇到 50 mm 降雨，落在頂面的雨水約 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³，即約 2,160 L；只要其中一成滲入空腔，就有約 216 L 的水進入隔熱材與石膏板。數值為教學假設。~The 43.2 m² top of a 3.6 m × 12 m module left uncovered in a 50 mm rainfall receives about 43.2×0.05 = 2.16 m³, roughly 2,160 L; if only a tenth enters the cavities, about 216 L of water reaches the insulation and plasterboard. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 安裝期間每天收工前檢查模組頂部的臨時防水覆蓋，雨後以含水率計抽查空腔內木料、石膏板與隔熱材；完工前確認空腔分隔完整，並以內視鏡或預留開口抽查鋼接頭的防蝕狀況。~During installation inspect temporary waterproof covers on module tops before the end of each shift, spot-check moisture content of timber, plasterboard and insulation in cavities with a moisture meter after rain, and before completion confirm cavity barriers are complete and check corrosion protection of steel joints through borescopes or planned openings.
units.failure: 施工中臨時防水覆蓋不足，雨水滲入多層模組的空腔，完工後出現發霉、地板變形與異味，只能拆開大量內裝乾燥與更換；空腔分隔遺漏時，火災中的煙可在住戶察覺前擴散到其他樓層。~Inadequate temporary weather protection lets rain into cavities across several module levels, and after completion mould, buckled floors and odours appear, requiring extensive linings to be opened, dried and replaced; missing cavity barriers let smoke from a fire spread to other floors before occupants notice.
units.misconception: 模組在工廠已做好防水，現場吊裝期間不需要另外防雨。~Modules are waterproofed in the factory, so no rain protection is needed during site installation.
units.practice: 施工計畫要規定每一層吊裝完成後的臨時防水程序與責任人，雨後含水率超過門檻的模組須乾燥並經檢查員確認才能封閉；空腔分隔位置要在圖面與現場標示，並列入消防查驗項目。~The construction plan must set the temporary waterproofing procedure and responsible person after each level is lifted; modules whose moisture content exceeds the threshold after rain must be dried and cleared by the inspector before closing, and cavity-barrier locations must be marked on drawings and on site and included in fire inspections.

units.title: 模組履歷、維修更換與交接~Module records, repair and handover
units.mechanism: 模組建築的每個箱體都是可追溯的產品：材料批號、焊接與試驗紀錄、安裝位置、墊片厚度與接頭檢查都應與模組編號連結。日後改裝時，住戶或設計者必須知道哪些牆是承重框架、哪些是可拆隔間、接頭位在哪裡；若需要修理或更換某個模組，也要知道它的連接方式與吊出路徑。把這些紀錄連到資產資訊模型交給業主，才能讓工廠品質延續到營運期。~Each box in a modular building is a traceable product: material batches, welding and test records, installed location, shim thickness and joint inspections should all be linked to the module number. In later alterations occupants and designers must know which walls are structural frame, which are removable partitions and where the joints are; if a module must be repaired or replaced, its connections and lift-out route must also be known. Linking these records to the asset information model at handover is what carries the factory's quality into operation.
units.model: 以 1,866 個模組、每個模組約 30 個品質檢查點估算，共 1,866×30 = 55,980 筆紀錄；若不符合率 0.5%，約有 280 筆需追蹤處置與結案。模組數取自公開案例，檢查點數與不符合率為教學假設。~With 1,866 modules and about 30 quality checkpoints per module there are 1,866×30 = 55,980 records; at a 0.5% nonconformance rate about 280 items need tracking and close-out. The module count comes from a public case; checkpoints and nonconformance rate are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前抽查模組編號、位置與紀錄是否一致，確認所有不符合事項已結案；交接文件應包含模組配置圖、承重構件標示、接頭詳圖與檢查紀錄、維護與改裝限制，並由業主的設施管理單位確認可查詢。~Before handover, spot-check that module numbers, positions and records agree and that every nonconformance is closed; the handover set should include the module layout, identification of structural elements, joint details and inspection records, and maintenance and alteration limits, confirmed as searchable by the owner's facilities team.
units.failure: 交接資料只有一般竣工圖，沒有標示模組框架與接頭位置，多年後住戶裝修時切開模組角柱旁的牆，削弱承重框架；需要更換受損模組時，也找不到原始接頭設計與吊裝資料。~Handover with only general as-built drawings, without module frames and joint locations, lets a later tenant fit-out cut a wall beside a corner post and weaken the structural frame; when a damaged module needs replacing, nobody can find the original joint design or lifting data.
units.misconception: 模組建築完工後就與一般建築相同，不需要保存模組層級的資料。~Once completed, a modular building is like any other and needs no module-level records.
units.practice: 業主管理規約與使用手冊應寫明模組承重構件不得任意切割，任何改裝須經結構技師評估；模組履歷由業主長期保存，並在產權移轉時一併移交。~The owners' rules and user manual must state that structural module members may not be cut freely and that any alteration requires assessment by a structural engineer; module records are kept long-term by the owner and passed on with any change of ownership.

example: 設計練習：一棟 20 層鋼構模組建築，每層 8 個模組，共 8×20 = 160 個。每個模組吊裝循環（掛鉤、吊升、定位、鎖固、回程）40 分鐘，總吊裝時間 160×40/60 ≈ 106.7 小時；每天可吊裝 6 小時，需 106.7/6 ≈ 17.8 天，若預留 25% 風雨停工，約 17.8/0.75 ≈ 23.7 天，取 24 個工作天。起重機在 40 m 半徑的額定荷重 28 t，模組 22 t 加吊裝框 2.5 t 與索具 0.5 t，吊重 25 t，使用率 25/28 ≈ 89%。若裝修與設備使模組增重 8% 成 22×1.08 = 23.76 t，吊重 26.76 t，使用率 26.76/28 ≈ 96%，超過 90% 的規劃上限，須縮短半徑、移位起重機或改用較大機型。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案；實際吊裝計畫須由合格的吊掛負責人核准。~Design exercise: a 20-storey steel modular building has 8 modules per floor, 8×20 = 160 in all. Each lifting cycle (hook on, hoist, place, bolt, return) takes 40 minutes, so total hook time is 160×40/60 ≈ 106.7 hours; at 6 lifting hours a day this needs 106.7/6 ≈ 17.8 days, and allowing 25% for wind and rain about 17.8/0.75 ≈ 23.7 days, so 24 working days. The crane is rated 28 t at 40 m radius; a 22 t module plus a 2.5 t lifting frame and 0.5 t of rigging gives a 25 t hook load and 25/28 ≈ 89% utilisation. If finishes and equipment add 8% to the module, 22×1.08 = 23.76 t, the hook load is 26.76 t and utilisation 26.76/28 ≈ 96%, above a 90% planning limit, so the radius must be shortened, the crane moved or a larger crane used. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real project; an actual lifting plan must be approved by a competent lifting supervisor.
history: 以工廠預製構件組成建築的想法由來已久，英國 1957 年成立的 CLASP 以預製系統大量興建學校；1967 年蒙特婁世界博覽會的 Habitat 67 由 Moshe Safdie 設計，以 354 個預製混凝土箱體堆疊成住宅群，成為體積模組的代表作。2010 年代模組建築往高層發展：紐約 461 Dean Street 於 2012 年動工、2016 年以 32 層開幕，當時被稱為世界最高的模組公寓；新加坡自 2014 年起要求部分政府售地住宅採用 PPVC，The Clement Canopy 以兩棟 40 層塔樓、1,866 個混凝土模組完成。2021 年 ICC 與模組建築協會發布 1200 與 1205 兩項異地建造標準。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~The idea of assembling buildings from factory-made parts is old: CLASP, formed in England in 1957, built many schools from a prefabricated system, and Habitat 67, designed by Moshe Safdie for the 1967 Montreal Expo, stacked 354 precast concrete boxes into housing and became the emblem of volumetric construction. In the 2010s modular building went high-rise: 461 Dean Street in New York broke ground in 2012 and opened in 2016 at 32 storeys, billed at the time as the world's tallest modular apartment building, and Singapore required PPVC on selected Government Land Sales housing sites from 2014, with The Clement Canopy completed as two 40-storey towers from 1,866 concrete modules. In 2021 the ICC and the Modular Building Institute issued the off-site construction standards 1200 and 1205. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: The Clement Canopy 為兩棟 40 層、共 505 戶的住宅，2 至 40 樓以 1,866 個六面混凝土模組建造~The Clement Canopy has two 40-storey towers with 505 units, with levels 2 to 40 built from 1,866 six-sided concrete modules
新加坡建設局稱 40 層的 The Clement Canopy 為世界最高的混凝土 PPVC 建築~Singapore's Building and Construction Authority describes the 40-storey Clement Canopy as the world's tallest concrete PPVC building
新加坡自 2014 年 11 月 1 日起要求部分政府售地非有地住宅採用 PPVC~Singapore has required PPVC for selected non-landed Government Land Sales housing since 1 November 2014
新加坡建設局表示 PPVC 可節省最多約 40% 的人力與時間，每層結構循環時間最多縮短約 30%~Singapore's BCA states PPVC can save up to about 40% in manpower and time and cut structural floor-cycle time by up to about 30%

Habitat 67 於 1967 年完成，由 354 個約 11.7 m × 5.3 m × 3 m 的預製混凝土模組組成~Habitat 67 was completed in 1967 from 354 precast concrete modules of about 11.7 m × 5.3 m × 3 m

ICC/MBI 1200 與 1205 兩項異地建造標準於 2021 年發布，分別涵蓋規劃設計製造組裝與檢查法規符合~The ICC/MBI 1200 and 1205 off-site construction standards were issued in 2021, covering planning, design, fabrication and assembly, and inspection and regulatory compliance
